correctness.rationale: Reflection invariance forces both unique extremal ellipsoids to be centered and diagonal. The candidate inscribed ellipsoid with cap semiaxes lies inside the ball since a_i≤1. Strictly concave log-volume/KKT gives z_i=min(a_i²,t) for the inscribed box, and signed corner contact vectors sum to the identity for its Löwner ellipsoid. For all x in K, split ∑x_i²/m_i² into ||x||²/t plus active-cap corrections and use ∑min(a_i²,t)=1 to bound it by d, giving H⊂K⊂L(H). Water-level existence, ties, S≤1, equality cases are checked. Independent exact rational KKT checks used 501 cap configurations; they are corroboration only.
